derivation: Actual features, launch scope, claims, due gate and dependency impact determine required cases. Missing access is not N/A; examples do not close QA.

cases.applies_when: Every binary, configuration or content release
cases.procedure_pattern: Compare candidate hashes and model, rule, catalog and save versions with the QA freeze. Change one config in a test copy.
cases.expected_observable: The mismatch marks affected proof stale and triggers scoped retesting. Preserve only valid existing results.
cases.oracle_source_kind: QA freeze; dependency closure; build receipts

cases.applies_when: Every launch scope with first-use learning
cases.procedure_pattern: Exercise clean install, first meaningful action, failure and retry, reward and save, and next goal. Resume a lapsed profile.
cases.expected_observable: All applicable transitions work in the exact release candidate. Release export preserves learning and recovery.

cases.applies_when: Launch content, encounters or progression apply
cases.procedure_pattern: Compare actual content families, early, mid and late progression and optional paths with the manifest and store claims. Run curated boundary cases.
cases.expected_observable: Advertised mechanics exist at release, required launch content is present, and known generation and reachability constraints hold.
cases.oracle_source_kind: content manifest; world/progression grammar; QA matrix

cases.applies_when: Accepted references and target tiers exist
cases.procedure_pattern: Compare same-state release frames, motion, sound, input and camera. Test mute, disabled haptics and reduced motion where applicable.
cases.expected_observable: Accepted scope and tolerances hold and critical cues remain available. Report unverified physical properties separately.

cases.applies_when: A store, in-app purchase or offers apply
cases.procedure_pattern: Exercise eligible, ineligible, expired and owned offers with current, stale and unavailable prices. Test buy, cancel, back, use and expiry.
cases.expected_observable: Contents, duration, limits and local store price are visible before commitment. Decline and recovery work and trial and switching follow declared refill behavior.

cases.procedure_pattern: In sandbox test pending, failure, cancel and success, outage and process death during verify, grant or acknowledgement, and duplicate or reordered callbacks.
cases.expected_observable: A verified purchase grants once durably and pending grants no access. Reconciliation, acknowledgement and consumption follow official store behavior.
cases.oracle_source_kind: current platform lifecycle; authoritative transaction rules

cases.applies_when: Products can be restored or refunded
cases.procedure_pattern: In sandbox restore after reinstall or account switch, repeat restore, refund or revoke and check a consumed consumable.
cases.expected_observable: Restore only eligible entitlement. Consumed items remain consumed, revocation and expiry match recovery rules, and saves persist.
Show a clear reward before opt-in. Decline and no-fill preserve core play, valid earned rewards grant once, and restart and clock skew preserve limits.
cases.oracle_source_kind: placement/reward/cap policy; current ad platform rules

cases.applies_when: Boosts, paid mechanics or an attempt economy apply
cases.procedure_pattern: Never-pay/no-offer/full-paid portfolios; overlap/expiry/restore; test strongest allowed synergy
cases.expected_observable: The live catalog preserves declared caps, overlapping-access rules, free goals and ways to earn progress. Check for unspecified cumulative budget bypass or dominance.

cases.procedure_pattern: Supported historical fixtures → migration; kill/retry; truncated/low-storage/offline conflict; restore backup
cases.expected_observable: Migration is idempotent and interruption-safe and preserves progress and entitlements without duplication. Expose incompatibility and roll-forward or rollback boundaries.

cases.applies_when: Every store release, with SDK and data behavior where applicable
cases.procedure_pattern: Compare actual SDKs and network permissions with dated official rules and disclosures. Check age, consent, deletion and reviewer access.
cases.expected_observable: The snapshot is dated. Actual data, age, ads, IAP, rights and store claims match. Mark missing checks blocked and keep secrets out of deliverables.

cases.procedure_pattern: Install, update and launch on representative tiers. Exercise sustained worst-case gameplay and UI, interruptions, thermal behavior, audio and input.
cases.expected_observable: Frame-time distribution, memory, thermal performance and recovery meet agreed limits. Track physical proofs independently of simulator results and report gaps.

cases.applies_when: Upload, submission or rollout is authorized
cases.procedure_pattern: Check target, version, channel, regions and authorized price scope. Reconcile unknown outcomes and exercise smoke and stop procedures.
cases.expected_observable: Record actual receipt and provider state. Verify upload and availability separately. Define compatibility and entitlement limits for halt, feature flags, backend changes and forward repair.
cases.oracle_source_kind: current authorization; provider state; rollback-forward runbook
